question: Which political leader quit Indian National Congress following differences with party leadership in May 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kapil Sibal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kapil Sibal quit the Indian National Congress following differences with party leadership in May 2022.**
 
• He was upset with the handling of the party's poor performance in the recently concluded assembly elections.
 
• He had also criticized the party leadership for not taking a strong stand on issues such as the farmers' protests and the handling of the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• Sibal is a senior lawyer and a former Union Minister who has been associated with the Congress party for several decades.
 
• His resignation has come as a big blow to the Congress party, which is already grappling with internal dissent and leadership issues.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Sonia Gandhi **is the current interim president of the Indian National Congress. She has been associated with the party for several decades and has held v arious leadership positions in the past.
 
• **Mallikarjun Kharge** is a senior Congress leader from Karnataka. He is currently the Leader of the Opposition in the Rajya Sabha, the upper house of the Indian parliament.
 
• Shashi Tharoor is a Congress MP from Kerala. He is a well-known author, diplomat, and politician who has been associated with the party for several years. However, there have been no reports of him quitting the party recently.
